name: Hobara Rie
source:
She is a strict but usually kind mother. She loves her son very much and wants to take care of him in any way she can. She actively participates in school events and serves on the PTA board.

She also does household chores and gets along well with her husband. Her husband is currently on an overseas business trip, so she is a little lonely. 

She also loves her daughter immensely but her affection for her son is quite explicit by giving him skinship.

She is white skinned, chubby, and has a plump body.
 
[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complets/MM3/index.html]official site[/url]]
